description: This file contains utility functions and types for managing team and organization invitations, including permission checks, user creation, invite handling, and email notifications within a team/organization management system.

methods.name: ensureAtleastAdminPermissions
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to invite to a team or organization, throws error if not authorized.

methods.name: checkInputEmailIsValid
methods.description: Validates if the provided email address is valid, throws error if invalid.

methods.name: getUniqueInvitationsOrThrowIfEmpty
methods.description: Removes duplicate invitations and throws error if no invitations are provided.

methods.name: canBeInvited
methods.description: Determines if a user can be invited to a specific team, considering existing memberships and profiles.

methods.name: findUsersWithInviteStatus
methods.description: Fetches users from database matching invitation emails/usernames and assesses their invite status.

methods.name: getOrgConnectionInfo
methods.description: Determines organization ID and auto-accept status based on email domain and team info.

methods.name: createNewUsersConnectToOrgIfExists
methods.description: Creates new user accounts and connects them to an organization or team based on invitations.

methods.name: getOrgState
methods.description: Returns organization-related state info such as verification, auto-accept, and publication status.

methods.name: getAutoJoinStatus
methods.description: Determines if an invitee can auto-join a team or organization, and if profile or membership creation is needed.

methods.name: groupUsersByJoinability
methods.description: Splits users into those who can auto-join and those who cannot, based on auto-accept logic.

methods.name: handleExistingUsersInvites
methods.description: Processes invitations for existing users, creating memberships, profiles, and sending emails accordingly.

methods.name: handleNewUsersInvites
methods.description: Handles invitations for new users, creating accounts, memberships, and sending verification emails.
